title: CharacterBody2D with CapsuleShape2D collision gets stuck between other colliders
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot v4.7.1.stable (a13da4feb)

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable (a13da4feb) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.1.4-200.fc44.x86_64) - AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8840HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 27.04 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In Threadbare (an open-source top-down adventure game) we usually have reports ([example](https://github.com/endlessm/threadbare/issues/2704), [another](https://github.com/endlessm/threadbare/issues/2588)) of the player (a CharacterBody2D) getting stuck while walking, upon colliding with things in the world (usually StaticBody2Ds or other CharacterBody2Ds). These bugs are usually work-arounded by changing the level design, but they keep coming. So I came up with a minimal reproduction project (attached). Here is also a video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d1958f52-4477-4965-a1f7-d8407fb83337

I used the Game tab to record it in slow-motion, and you can see how the player capsule collider "gets sucked" into the others (2 capsules and a circle shape).

This can also be reproduced online from the web build, at this level: https://play.threadbare.game/branches/endlessm/main/#dev/dev_archipelago (from which I extracted the MRP).

Note that this is a top-down so the CharacterBody2D is in motion_mode Floating.

I played with all the settings I could but couldn't get the player to reliably not get stuck. For example: changed `safe_margin`, `wall_min_slide_angle`, `collision_priority`.

I checked the pool of issues and it looks like this one might be related https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/82145 . Although not exactly the same?

I discussed this in Godot Meetup Argentina and people motivated me to report it as a bug. In that group I was discussing what real games do about this. If the physics engine is supposed to have these unreliabilities, feel free to close the ticket!

### Steps to reproduce

Play the MRP or [this link](https://play.threadbare.game/branches/endlessm/main/#dev/dev_archipelago). Try to walk between the tree and the NPC from the left side. You will get stuck between them and the rock.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[player-got-stuck-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31322412/player-got-stuck-mrp.zip)
